name: Peb Fort (Vikatgad)
tagline: A quiet fort trek from Neral — Matheran's less-crowded neighbor
seoTitle: Peb Fort (Vikatgad) Solo Trek Guide — The Solo Trail
seoDescription: Solo trekker's guide to Peb Fort near Neral and Matheran — a quieter alternative fort trek, season, safety, and packing.

routeOptions.name: From Neral
routeOptions.notes: Reached easily by train to Neral — good option if traveling from Mumbai without a car.

safety.intro: Peb Fort is quieter than nearby Matheran and Prabalgad, which means less foot traffic to rely on if something goes wrong.

cards.title: Before you go
items: Less crowded than neighboring treks — tell someone your plan
Combine with a Matheran day trip if you want a fuller day out

cards.title: On the trail
items: Forest sections can be overgrown post-monsoon — watch the path markers
Some rocky scrambling near the fort itself

cards.title: Solo-specific
items: Quieter trail than most on this list — extra caution warranted going alone
Easily reached by train from Mumbai, useful if you don't have your own vehicle

items.name: Offline map of the route — less signage than popular forts
